classification_detail: Fully proven. A doubly periodic entire function is constant via Liouville's theorem. Key steps: (1) periodic_int_aux extends base periodicity to integer multiples via Int.induction_on, (2) range f is bounded because it equals f's image on the compact fundamental parallelogram {s + ti : s,t in [0,1]}, (3) Liouville's theorem (exists_const_forall_eq_of_bounded) concludes. The lattice decomposition z = fract(Re z) + fract(Im z)*I + floor(Re z) + floor(Im z)*I was the trickiest part, requiring Complex.ofReal_intCast to simplify Int-to-Complex casts.
